title: narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. provincialis
intro: Narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. provincialis, commonly known as the Provençal daffodil or Narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. pseudonarcissus, is a subspecies of the wild daffodil (Narcissus pseudonarcissus). This plant is a perennial bulbous geophyte with medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine. The Provençal daffodil is known for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as relaxing muscles and reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and other compounds that have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties, including galanthamine, a cholinesterase inhibitor, and other flavonoids and phenolic acids.
